Husband-Wife Duo Arrested with Drugs in Katihar

Katihar police arrested a husband and wife with 18 lakh worth of smack, totaling 204.90 grams of narcotic substance. In a separate incident, Gurdaspur police seized a large quantity of illegal liquor from a car during an operation against drug smugglers.
